description: Recent SIP Time Series (up to 30k bars). Retrieve recent bars or trades for a SIP symbol. Tick data is unadjusted. → Returns code, bar_type, last_update (Unix milliseconds), and series. Bars contain time, open, high, low, close, and volume; tick points contain time, close, volume, and optional trade_id, trade_exchange, tape, and trade_conditions. Point time is Unix seconds. With abbr=true, rows follow series_keys and may contain nulls, strings, or string arrays. Empty series may omit series_keys. Use get_sip_history for earlier intraday periods or get_sip_trades for all available trades on one date.

abbr.description: Set to true to return series as arrays with a series_keys array of field names. Empty series may omit series_keys.

bar_interval.description: Bar interval. Tick and second bars use 1.

dadj.description: (Optional) Dividend adjustment for equities and etfs (has no effect on assets without dividends). Only applies when split=true. Default to false.

dp.description: The minimum value of 1 is preserved; values from 2 are rounded up to the next multiple of 500 data points. Default is 3000. Supported values: 1 - 30000.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

split.description: (Optional) Split adjustment for equities and ETFs. Default to true. When false, returns unadjusted data and overrides dadj.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_sip_series
